```{r setup, include = FALSE, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
	echo = FALSE,
	message = FALSE,
	warning = FALSE,
	fig.keep = 'all'
)

# the shortcut for pipe is ctrl+shift+M
#### Install and load packages ####
library(car) #companion to applied regression
library(tidyverse) # all tidyverse packages including tidyr, dplyr, and ggplot2
library(ggpubr) # plot aesthetics
library(flextable) # tidy display table package
library(googlesheets4)

#### Create plot theme ####
theme_set(theme( 
   panel.background = element_blank(), # remove panel background
   # panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(), # remove minor x axis grid line
   # panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), # remove major x axis grid line
   panel.grid = element_blank(), # remove all grid lines
   axis.text = element_text(size = 13,color = 'black'), #makes axis labels bigger
   axis.title = element_text(size = 15), #makes axis title bigger and bold
   # axis.ticks = element_blank(),
   # axis.title.y = element_text(margin=margin(0,10,0,5)), #pushes the y axis title away from the y axis labels
   # axis.text.x = element_text(margin=margin(0,0,20,0)), #pushes the x axis title away from the x axis labels and pushes the bars down closer to the x axis labels
   legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
   legend.text  = element_text(size = 16),
   legend.background = element_blank(),
   panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5), # border around the whole plot
   plot.title = element_text(size = 15)
   #legend.key = element_blank()
))
```

```{r read in data}
upc <- read_csv('GFNMS UPC data entry (all years) - load_to_R.csv') %>% #downloaded on 2026-08-28
  dplyr::mutate(site = replace(site, site == 'timber', 'Timber')) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(site = replace(site, site == 'fort_ross', 'Fort Ross')) %>%   
  dplyr::mutate(site = replace(site, site == 'shell_beach', 'Shell Beach')) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(site = replace(site, site == 'pebble_beach', 'Pebble Beach')) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(site = replace(site, site == 'ocean', 'Ocean')) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(site = replace(site, site == 'gerstle', 'Gerstle'))
# make year factor for plotting
upc$year = as.factor(upc$year)
```

```{r check data for completeness, include = FALSE}
# assign transect ID for ease of sorting later

# number of surveys completed per site per year
tot_upc_site_year <- upc %>% 
  dplyr::count(year, site, transect_ID) %>% 
  dplyr::count(year, site) %>% 
  mutate(survey_type = 'UPC')

# compared with swath inventory. PISCO_swath is from the subtidal_swath.Rmd script.
PISCO_swaths <- swath_target_den %>% filter(transect_ID %in% PISCO_transects$transect_ID)

tot_PISCO_swaths <- PISCO_swaths %>% 
  count(year, site, transect_ID) %>% 
  count(year, site) %>% 
  mutate(survey_type = 'swaths')

full_join(tot_PISCO_swaths, tot_upc_site_year) %>%
  arrange(year, site) %>%
  flextable()

# check that there are 90 observations per transect (30 for substrate, 30 for relief, 30 for cover. Exclude superlayer for this check)..
upc %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!category == 'SUPERLAYER') %>%
  dplyr::group_by(transect_ID) %>% # group by replicate transect
  dplyr::summarise(count = sum(count)) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!count == 90) 

# they're all very close to 90 or have a known missing segment so we're all good here :) 
```

```{r complete incomplete surveys}
# some surveys did not finish, and some have missing or extra points. I think we can resolve this by forcing all surveys into 30 observations in each category based on proportions.


```

```{r substrate}
# how much of each transect was bedrock, boulder, cobble, etc?
upc_substrate <- upc %>%
  dplyr::group_by(year, month, day, site, subsite, transect_ID, category, classcode) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(count = sum(count)) %>% # sum the three segments per transect
  dplyr::filter(category == 'SUBSTRATE') %>%
  dplyr::group_by(year, month, day, site, subsite, transect_ID, classcode) %>% # group by replicate transect
  dplyr::summarise(count = sum(count)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(proportion = count / sum(count))  %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(count_extrap = proportion * 30)

# Check that all proportions add to one.
upc_substrate %>%
  group_by(transect_ID) %>%
  summarise(prop_sum = sum(proportion)) %>%
  filter(!prop_sum == 1) # zero rows do not equal one. yay

# Proportion of substrates at all sites, not separated by year
upc_substrate %>%
  # dplyr::group_by(site, classcode) %>%
  # dplyr::summarise(mean_prop = mean(proportion), n = n()) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = classcode, y = proportion)) +
  facet_wrap(~site) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  ggtitle('Proportion of substrates in UPC surveys all years') +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 55, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))

# Stacked column chart
upc_substrate %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = site, y = count, fill = classcode)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 55, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))

# check for changes at FRC and TC
upc_substrate %>% 
  filter(site %in% c('Fort Ross', 'Timber', 'Gerstle', 'Ocean')) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = count, fill = classcode)) +
  facet_wrap(~site) +
  geom_col() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 55, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))
  
# # boxplots
# upc_substrate %>%
```

# Combine UPC and swaths in full analysis of all data taken!
```{r combine UPC and swaths}
# Nonmetric multidimensional scaling plots showing community dissimilarities 
# to visualize how the communities are different

# all these UPC tibbles are QAQCed for completeness in the proportion column. 
upc_cover
upc_relief
upc_substrate
PISCO_swaths

upc_all <- # all proportions add up! I checked.
  bind_rows(upc_cover, upc_relief, upc_substrate) %>% 
  select(!count) %>% 
  mutate(observations = count_extrap) %>% # make a col of observations that can be merged with PISCO_swaths observations\
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(year, month, day, site, transect_ID, classcode, observations)

PISCO_swaths_all <- PISCO_swaths %>% 
  mutate(observations = den_m2_corrected) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(year, month, day, site, transect_ID, classcode, observations)

# MERGE THE SWATHS AND UPCS!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
PISCO_all <- bind_rows(PISCO_swaths_all, upc_all) %>% 
  arrange(year, month, day, site, transect_ID, classcode)
```

# NMDS analysis using swath and UPC surveys combined. Should probably make this a separate script.
```{r NMDS analysis with fully combined dataset}
################## much of below is copied from subtidal_swath.Rmd #######################   
### and now I attempt to do the same analysis with this fuller dataset that includes UPC observations ###

# check if each transect ID has a all types of surveys done. so check for strpur, nerlue, ptecalad, atmin, bedrk, 10cm-1m. 
PISCO_all_ms %>% 
  filter(classcode %in% c('STRPUR', 'NERLUE', 'PATMIN', 'PTECALAD', 'BEDRK', '10cm-1m')) %>% 
  count(year, site, transect_ID) %>% 
  filter(!n == 6) #lookin good. the ones with only 5 obseravtions just didn't have a UPC classcode since I didn't include implicit zeros for those yet.

PISCO_all_ms %>%
  count(transect_ID, classcode) %>%
  filter(n > 1) #ok STEOSM has multiple observations for one of the transects because it was observed in both algae swath and UPC. That prevents the matrix from forming properly, so I'm going to remove it from the UPC and think about this later.

# Reformatting the data frame for the analysis. cols need to be classcodes.
PISCO_all_ms_matrix <- PISCO_all_ms %>% 
  select(transect_ID, classcode, observations) %>% 
  # I want each col to be a classcode, rows to be IDs, and values to be observations.
  pivot_wider(names_from = 'classcode', values_from = 'observations') %>% 
  replace(is.na(.), 0) %>% # make any NA value into 0.
  as.data.frame()

PISCO_all_ms_matrix$transect_ID = NULL # remove transect_ID column

## Convert absolute abundance to relative abundance to standardize
# Aren't they already standardized? I mean they're all in number per m2. That feels standardized. Well Maria says to do this.
PISCO_all_ms_matrix_decostand <- decostand(PISCO_all_ms_matrix, method = 'total')

set.seed(19918) # set seed to make sure the metaMDS repeats a best solution.
PISCO_all_ms_MDS1 <- metaMDS(PISCO_all_ms_matrix_decostand, distance = 'bray') # stress value should be between 0 and 0.2 according to https://jkzorz.github.io/2019/06/06/NMDS.html.# My stress value is 0.07.

## reformat so it can be plotted in ggplot with groupings.
PISCO_all_ms_data_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(PISCO_all_ms_MDS1)$sites)

## Add back identifier columns
PISCO_all_ms_data_scores$transect_ID = unique(PISCO_all_ms$transect_ID) 

#*** Bookmark. pick up here trying to add the metadata back to the MDS. #***

# i want to join this with the sites and dates and stuff.
PISCO_all_ms_sites <- PISCO_all_ms %>%
  dplyr::select(transect_ID, site, year, month, day) # just these cols
# PISCO_all_sites <- PISCO_all_sites[!duplicated(PISCO_all_sites),] # remove duplicate rows 
dim(PISCO_all_ms_sites) # check dimensions. 5643 rows.

PISCO_all_ms_NMDS_sites <- dplyr::left_join(PISCO_all_ms_data_scores, PISCO_all_ms_sites, by = 'transect_ID') 
rownames(PISCO_all_ms_matrix_decostand) = paste(PISCO_all_ms_NMDS_sites$site, PISCO_all_ms_NMDS_sites$transect_ID)
```

```{r fig.cap = 'Community dissimilarities (Bray-Curtis) among subtidal swath transects at all sites. Species vectors shown for significant species only (P < 0.05)'}
# Prepping the species vectors
spp_fit <- envfit(PISCO_all_ms_MDS1, PISCO_all_ms_matrix_decostand, permutations = 999) # there were 50+ warnings bc SD = 0.
spp_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(spp_fit, display = 'vectors'))
spp_scores <- cbind(spp_scores, species = rownames(spp_scores))
spp_scores <- cbind(spp_scores, pval = spp_fit$vectors$pvals)
sig_spp_scores <- subset(spp_scores, pval <= 0.05) %>% arrange(pval) # this is where it filters for P <= 0.05
sig_spp_scores$site = 'Timber' # just put one so it plots
sig_spp_scores$year = '2022' # just put one so it plots
# reposition the overlapping species labels
sig_spp_scores$NMDS1_label = sig_spp_scores$NMDS1
sig_spp_scores$NMDS2_label = sig_spp_scores$NMDS2
# sig_spp_scores$NMDS1_label[which(sig_spp_scores$species == 'LAMREC')] = 0.65 # format for readjusting labels

ggplot(PISCO_all_ms_NMDS_sites, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = site, shape = year)) +
  stat_ellipse() +
  # annotate('text', x = 2, y = 1.2, label = paste('Stress =', round(PISCO_all_ms_MDS1$stress, digits = 3))) +
  ggtitle('Swath community dissimilarities') +
  geom_segment(data = sig_spp_scores, aes(x = 0, xend = NMDS1, y = 0, yend = NMDS2), color = 'grey80', arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")), lwd = 0.3) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  annotate('text', size = 3, x = sig_spp_scores$NMDS1_label, y = sig_spp_scores$NMDS2_label, label = sig_spp_scores$species, color = 'grey60') +
  my_theme +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 12), axis.text = element_text(size = 12))

```
